logentry.msg: #BOP !REVISION: 15 Oct 2025 !AUTHOR: J. G. de Mattos !SUBJECT: Standardize output labels and improve readability in smg_setup.sh !FILES: M etc/smg_setup.sh !DESCRIPTION: • Renamed path label “beegfs” → “submit” for consistency across environments • Adjusted column headers (“Search Paths”) and output alignment (13-char width) • Added visual separators between report entries for clearer readability • Updated log messages to reflect new terminology (“SUBMIT_HOME”) • Enhances clarity of build/report outputs for multi-site SMNA workflows #EOP

logentry.author: joao.gerd
logentry.msg: #BOP !REVISION: 13 Oct 2025 !AUTHOR: J. G. de Mattos !SUBJECT: Enhance build verification report and GSI compile block !FILES: M etc/smg_setup.sh !DESCRIPTION: • Added structured reporting buckets (READY_ROWS, BUILT_ONLY_ROWS, RUNTIME_ONLY_ROWS, MISSING_ROWS) for clearer end-of-run summaries. • Implemented _print_group() function to render colorized, aligned tables for each report category. • Improved post-copy reclassification logic: items fixed via rsync or cp are dynamically promoted to READY status. • Enhanced diagnostic messages for directory creation and copy failures. • Updated GSI compilation section: – Fixed path verification to use home_gsi_bin instead of home_gsi_src. – Adjusted copy paths to home_gsi_src/gsi/gsi.x. – Refined error message to clarify unset path variables (home_gsi || home_gsi_src || home_gsi_bin). !NOTES: These changes improve the readability and accuracy of the build validation phase in smg_setup.sh, providing a comprehensive visual summary and robust error handling for the GSI compile and copy workflow. #EOP

logentry.msg: #BOP !REVISION: 13 Oct 2025 !AUTHOR: J. G. de Mattos !SUBJECT: Refine BAM_CoordSize() and standardize timestep documentation !FILES: M cptec/bam/run/EnvironmentalVariables M run/scripts/gsi_scripts/runGSI_Functions.sh M run/scripts/runGSI !DESCRIPTION: • Standardized inline timestep comments across all truncations in BAM_CoordSize() using the format “# 3600/<Δt>=<n> (aligned / not aligned)” for clarity and auditability • Updated T254 entry: replaced TimeStep=255 (non-submultiple of 3600) with 225 s to maintain correct synchronization of radiation calls at 1h and 3h intervals • Added detailed ProTex-style header describing Δt selection rationale: numerical stability, CFL control, and physics alignment • Verified that all other Δt values are exact submultiples of 3600 s or empirically stable • Linked to external documentation (Δt rationale and stability analysis): https://gist.github.com/joaogerd/3b95b4c29b29736c197bd3946a2f91fd #EOP

- scripts/run_obsmake.sh • Refactored observation pre-processing step for clarity. • Enhanced modularization to better integrate with run_cycle.sh.

logentry.author: joao.gerd
logentry.msg:
SMG core: centralizar setup, paths e help; remover duplicações
config_smg.ksh - Move o sourcing de etc/smg_setup.sh para o início do main() (uma única vez) - Remove sourcing duplicado e a chamada direta a use_local_cmake (setup centralizado) - Melhora o help: usa show_help; adiciona fallback listando funções quando necessário - Mantém mensagens de instalação (SMG_ROOT)
